defs.def: to think about sth carefully, especially in order to make a decision （尤指为作出决定而）仔细考虑，细想

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed, while the control group just matched a line drawing of the object with the artwork itself.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分为两组：“美”组被要求主动思考并为所看到的每件物品的美打分，而对照组只是将物品的线描图与艺术品本身进行匹配。

ex.s: The idea of sea level as a reference point for elevations has by now been around for so long as to go essentially unnoticed-we mention it without even considering what it means.
ex.t: 以海平面作为海拔参照点的想法如今已存在如此之久，以至于几乎被人忽视——我们提到它时甚至不去思考它的含义。

ex.s: Consider the best method to deliver your message.
ex.t: 考虑传递信息的最佳方法。

ex.s: If the information you’re communicating isn’t urgent, consider sending an email.
ex.t: 如果你传达的信息并不紧急，考虑发一封邮件。

ex.s: Considering the stories we tell about ourselves can help us to change our minds for better.
ex.t: 思考我们讲述的关于自己的故事，有助于我们改善自己的想法。

ex.s: We need to consider how we want our future with AI to pan out.
ex.t: 我们需要思考希望我们与人工智能的未来如何展开。

ex.s: Consider giving back to the communities you’re visiting.
ex.t: 考虑回馈你所游览的社区。

ex.s: This unbeatable price-point encouraged me to experiment with dozens of titles that I would never normally consider buying.
ex.t: 这种无可比拟的价格优势鼓励我去尝试了几十种我平时绝不会考虑购买的书籍。

ex.s: Before choosing to study online, consider whether you’re a self-motivated learner and if the material seems interesting enough to keep you going.
ex.t: 在选择在线学习之前，要考虑自己是否是一个有自学动力的人，以及学习材料是否足够有趣能让你坚持下去。

ex.s: Consider turning your travel plan over to a travel agent and letting him double-check all the details, make suggestions, and then handle the actual reservations.
ex.t: 考虑把你的旅行计划交给旅行代理，让他复核所有细节、提出建议，然后处理实际的预订。

ex.s: Consider and keep in mind why you want to make a change, including how the change reflects your values.
ex.t: 考虑并记住你为什么要做出改变，包括这种改变如何反映你的价值观。

ex.s: Though he acknowledges that engineering works can fail because the person who thought them up or engineered them simply got things wrong, in this book Dr Petroski widens his view to consider the larger context in which such failures occur.
ex.t: 尽管他承认，工程作品之所以会失败，可能是因为构想或设计它们的人犯了简单的错误，但在本书中，彼得罗斯基博士拓宽了视野，去考量此类失败发生的更大背景。

ex.s: The President seemed to consider her idea seriously.
ex.t: "如果我把黏土带到这里，每天下午工作三小时，我可以在你在办公桌前工作时完成大部分项目。"

ex.s: Since I was a kid, I`ve considered different job I would like to do.
ex.t: 从我还是个孩子起，我就考虑过我想从事的不同工作。

ex.s: But the next time you find yourself among strangers, consider that small talk is worth the trouble.
ex.t: 但下次你发现自己和陌生人在一起时，考虑一下闲聊是值得麻烦的。

ex.s: In the past, money's makeup varied from place to place, depending on what was considered valuable there.
ex.t: 在西非，青铜或铜手镯被用作现金，特别是如果交易与那里的奴隶贸易有关的话。

ex.s: Before turning to the economics definition of budget line, consider another concept: the line-item budget.
ex.t: 这种用法没有什么复杂的地方，预算线就是预算中的一行，上面注明了要购买的服务或商品及其成本，

ex.s: As early as 1966, biologists asked the government to consider reintroducing wolves to Yellowstone Park.
ex.t: 早在1966年，生物学家就请求政府考虑将狼重新引入黄石公园。

ex.s: Now that you know why you want to wake up, consider re-arranging your morning activities.
ex.t: 现在你已经知道为什么要早起了，考虑重新安排你的早晨活动吧。

ex.s: And consider setting a second alarm.
ex.t: 还要考虑设第二个闹钟。

ex.s: Make sure that any abbreviations and emojis you use are appropriate for the situation, and consider whether your readers will even know what you mean by BRB or COZ.
ex.t: 请确保您使用的任何缩写和表情符号都适合这种情况，并考虑您的读者是否会知道您所说的BRB或COZ是什么意思。

ex.s: We hope that you will consider...
ex.t: 我们希望你能考虑……

defs.def: to think of sb/sth in a particular way 认为；以为；觉得

ex.s: > The adviser considered the author’s experience in the lab a groundbreaking success because publishable data had been produced.
ex.t: > 顾问认为，作者在实验室的经验是一次开创性的成功，因为已经产生了可公布的数据。

ex.s: Do you consider the author as your role model?
ex.t: 你认为作者是你的榜样吗？

ex.s: Researchers use brain imaging technique to see which brain areas light up when we view paintings that we consider beautiful.
ex.t: 研究人员使用脑成像技术来观察当我们观看我们认为美丽的画作时，哪些大脑区域会被激活。

ex.s: In India and the Middle East, it’s considered very rude to eat with your left hand.
ex.t: 在印度和中东，用左手吃饭被认为是非常粗鲁的。

ex.s: C Mexicans consider it inappropriate to eat with utensils
ex.t: C 墨西哥人认为用餐具吃饭不合适

ex.s: He then made a small wooden horse, which Sullivan considered the best New Year present ever.
ex.t: 于是他做了一匹小木马，沙利文认为那是史上最好的新年礼物。

ex.s: It was first published in 1911 and is considered a classic of English children's literature.
ex.t: 它于1911年首次出版，被认为是英国儿童文学的经典之作。

ex.s: If you think you can do without the fence because you’ve never seen a fox, consider if the existence of the fence is precisely why you’ve never seen one.
ex.t: 如果你认为自己不需要围栏，因为你从没见过狐狸，那不妨想想：也许正是因为有了围栏，你才从没见过狐狸。

ex.s: Pele played professionally in Brazil for two decades, winning three World Cups along the way, and is considered to be one of the greatest football players.
ex.t: 贝利在巴西职业足坛效力了二十年，期间赢得了三届世界杯，被认为是最伟大的足球运动员之一。

defs.def: to think about sth, especially the feelings of other people, and be influenced by it when making a decision, etc. 体谅；考虑到；顾及

ex.s: I considered this when I met a thoughtful young businessman named Anthony.
ex.t: 当我遇到一位名叫安东尼、深思熟虑的年轻商人时，我想到了这一点。

ex.s: His strange habit makes sense when you consider that he’s an environmental scientist who studies how to reduce litter, including things that fall off garbage trucks as they drive down the road.
ex.t: 他奇怪的习惯在你想到他是一位研究如何减少垃圾的环境科学家时就有道理了，包括研究那些在垃圾车沿路行驶时从车上掉落的东西。

ex.s: Now he hopes that other cities will consider making their streets run smarter instead of just making them bigger.
ex.t: 现在，他希望其他城市能够考虑让它们的街道变得更智能，而不仅仅是让它们变得更大。

defs.def: to look carefully at sb/sth 端详；注视

没有 甚至 仔细考虑
